use.apple_touch_icon_png: iPhone and iPad home screen, Safari

icons.notImage: This file could not be read as an image.
icons.noSvgRoot: This SVG file has no {'<'}svg{'>'} root element.

preview.errorPage: The server answered {status}, so this is its error page, not the page itself.
preview.fetchedWith: Fetched with the {agent} user agent. Everything the page loads comes through this server, never straight from the site; with JavaScript off this is close to what a crawler reads before rendering.
preview.unreachable: The page could not be reached.
preview.notHtml: The server answered {status} with {type}, not an HTML page.

pwa.noManifest: This page links no web app manifest, so it cannot be installed as an app. Add {tag} to make it installable.

search.generated: The page has no meta description, so the snippet below is taken from the page text. Search engines may pick different text.
search.approx: Previews are approximate. Engines can rewrite titles and snippets per search, and show the favicon only after crawling the home page.

social.tooLarge: The share image is too large to show here: {link}.
social.cacheNote: Apps cache link previews. After changing tags, refresh them with Facebook's Sharing Debugger or LinkedIn's Post Inspector.

robots.notUrl: {at}: "{value}" is not a full URL; Sitemap needs https://…
robots.otherHost: {at}: the sitemap is on {host}, another host. That only works if that host also trusts it.
robots.beforeAgent: {at}: "{field}" comes before any User-agent line, so it applies to nobody.
robots.blockAll: "User-agent: *" has "Disallow: /": search engines will not crawl any page.
robots.noSitemap: No Sitemap line, so crawlers only find your sitemap through Search Console.
robots.tooLarge: Larger than 500 KiB; Google ignores everything after that.
robots.discardConfirm: Discard your unsaved changes to robots.txt?
robots.replacesApp: (it replaces the robots.txt your app generates now)
robots.placeholder: Empty: use the fix below to create a standard robots.txt.
robots.ok: Crawlers can read this file and find your sitemap.
robots.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Fixes only change the text until you save.

panel.subClick: sub-sitemaps · click one to open it
panel.unreadable: This file could not be read as a sitemap. Switch to Raw to see what the server sent.

inspect.noReport: The server did not send an inspection report. Reload the page and try again.
inspect.title: URL Inspection
inspect.subtitle: How Google, Bing and Yandex see a page, with search and share previews, favicon and web app checks.
inspect.crawlerNote: Fetching as a crawler shows whether the site serves bots something different. Some firewalls block requests that claim to be Googlebot but do not come from Google.
inspect.noSites: You have no websites yet. Create one, or switch to External URL to inspect any public page.

verify.title: Sitemap Verify
verify.subtitle: Finds your sitemaps through robots.txt, then lets you open each one and its sub-sitemaps.
verify.urlHelp: A site address finds its sitemap through robots.txt; a sitemap address is used directly.
verify.noSites: You have no websites yet. Create one, or switch to External URL to check any public site.

watermark.checkFailed: The image could not be checked.
watermark.chooseImage: Choose an image: PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or AVIF.
watermark.tooLarge: The image is larger than {size} MB.
watermark.cannotOpen: Your browser could not open this image.
watermark.tooManyPixels: The image is over 40 megapixels; resize it first.
watermark.removeFailed: The marks could not be removed.
watermark.copyFailed: A clean copy could not be created.
watermark.title: Image Watermark
watermark.subtitle: Check an image for watermarks, AI labels and ownership details, and remove visible marks such as logos, date stamps and text overlays.
watermark.drop: Drop an image here or click to choose
watermark.dropHint: PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or AVIF, up to {size} MB. The original file is checked as-is.
watermark.invisibleNote: This reads labels stored in the file. Invisible pixel watermarks such as SynthID are encoded into the image itself; this tool cannot reliably detect or remove them.
watermark.cleanNote: This removes embedded metadata and Content Credentials from the exported copy. It does not remove invisible pixel watermarks.
watermark.detect: Select only the mark inside the box
watermark.detectHint: Picks out text and logo strokes, leaving the background to rebuild from. Turn off to remove the whole box.
watermark.sensitivityHint: Raise it for faint, see-through marks; lower it if background detail gets selected.
watermark.growHint: Covers soft edges and shadows around the mark.
watermark.textureHint: Copies matching patches from around the mark; best on photos, grass, fabric and patterns.
watermark.smoothHint: Blends the surrounding colors inward; fastest, best for thin text on skies, walls and gradients.
watermark.ownOnly: Only remove marks from images you own or are licensed to edit.
watermark.stillApply: This image's {what} still apply after a visible mark is removed.
watermark.empty: Add an image to see what watermarks and AI labels it carries, then paint over a visible mark to remove it.
watermark.hintBox: Drag a box around the mark.
watermark.hintEraser: Paint to shrink the red selection.
watermark.hintBrush: Paint over the mark; it turns red.
watermark.hintAgain: Run it again on what's left for a cleaner result. The download is a new file without the original's metadata.
